note: Coastal community development dataset — the human and regional-development dimension of Sagarmala. Planned outputs, completed facilities, actual participation and measured outcomes are kept distinct. Employment figures published as programme projections are recorded as projections and never treated as measured outcomes. No social-impact estimate is invented.

coastal_context.text: Approximately 18 percent of India's population lives in the 72 coastal districts that comprise 12 percent of India's mainland. Under the holistic development of coastal districts, a total of 567 projects with an estimated cost of around ₹58,000 crore have been identified (secondary source mirroring ministry figures; date unpinned).

outcome_caveat.text: Beneficiary counts (30,000 fishermen; 40 lakh Ro-Pax passengers; 7,600 trained) are ministry-reported programme outputs, not independently measured outcomes. Techadyant records them as reported values with their sources and dates, and does not infer income or employment effects from infrastructure completion.
